name.description: The display name of the site.

base_url.description: The base URL of the site, used to resolve relative links.

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to collect before stopping.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of list pages to crawl. Single authoritative value for page count.

stop_on_duplicate.description: Stop crawling when a duplicate URL is encountered.

sources.description: Ordered list of classification sources. The first source that yields a non-empty value wins.

default.description: Fallback category used when no source yields a value.

category.description: Optional article classification into a single category.

sources.description: List of classification sources whose values are accumulated into the article tags.

tags.description: Optional auto-tagging configuration producing a list of tags.

list_page.description: List page configuration. Multiple named list sources (sources) provide distinct URL templates; a source can express a filter (keyword/category) if its URL contains the matching placeholder. Fields defined at this level (method/type/extract/pagination) act as defaults inherited by every source unless overridden.

method.description: Default request method inherited by all sources.

type.description: Default response type inherited by all sources.

extract.description: Default list extraction config inherited by all sources; deep-merged with a source's own extract.

pagination.description: Default pagination inherited by all sources.

url.description: List URL template. May contain {page}, {keyword} and {category} placeholders; each present placeholder declares the filter the source supports.

sources.description: Ordered list of list URL templates. The first source without a {keyword} placeholder is the default list; keyword/category requests pick the best matching source (exact match first, then superset, then graceful degradation).

categories.description: Optional mapping of category name to its in-site URL value, used by --category.

category_default.description: Optional default value for the {category} placeholder when --category is not given.

fields.description: Map of output field names to a CSS selector / JSON path (string) or a field configuration object. The valid field configuration form depends on article_page.type (see the conditional schemas below).

list_extract.description: List page extract config. Use the HTML form for HTML list pages and the JSON form for JSON list pages.

item_selector.description: CSS selector for the container of each list item.

link_selector.description: CSS selector for the link element within an item.

link_attr.description: Attribute to read the link URL from (default: href).

items_path.description: JSON path to the list of items.

url_field.description: Field name holding the article URL within each item.

url_template.description: URL template with a {url} placeholder used to build the final URL.

list_extract_partial.description: Partial list extract override within a list source. Deep-merged over the list_page-level extract, so only the fields being overridden need to be present.

item_selector.description: CSS selector for the container of each list item.

link_selector.description: CSS selector for the link element within an item.

link_attr.description: Attribute to read the link URL from (default: href).

items_path.description: JSON path to the list of items.

url_field.description: Field name holding the article URL within each item.

url_template.description: URL template with a {url} placeholder used to build the final URL.

classifier_source.description: A single classification source. The 'source' field selects the extraction strategy; 'mapping' optionally translates raw values into display names.

regex.description: Regular expression matched against the article URL. The first capture group is used as the raw value.

split.description: Delimiter used to split the raw value into multiple tags/categories.

selector.description: CSS selector targeting element(s) in the article HTML.

multiple.description: When true, collect all matching elements; otherwise take the first. Mutually exclusive with 'join'.

join.description: Delimiter used to join multiple matched values (category only); omitting it takes the first match. Mutually exclusive with 'multiple'.

split.description: Delimiter used to split the extracted value into multiple tags/categories.

from.description: JSON data source: json_ld (first JSON-LD block), list_data (list item meta), or article_json (article response body).

path.description: Dot-separated JSON path into the selected JSON data.

split.description: Delimiter used to split the extracted string value into multiple tags/categories.

value.description: Category or tag value assigned when any keyword matches the article title or content.

classifier_mapping.description: Maps raw extracted values to display names, e.g. {'7251': '股市'}.

html_field_config.description: Field config for HTML article pages. Requires a CSS selector.

datetime_format.description: strptime format used when as is 'datetime'.

regex.description: Regular expression applied to the extracted value.

json_field_config.description: Field config for JSON article pages. Requires a JSON path.

datetime_format.description: strptime format used when as is 'datetime'.

regex.description: Regular expression applied to the extracted value.
